en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town square with rows of two‑storey houses on both sides and a church tower with a clock and spire in the background. Young trees line the open, unpaved marketplace area in the foreground. Printed red and black German text is at the bottom margin, including the town and scene description, plus the publisher and year '1905'.
